verdict.rationale: Dev Mode shows code snippets for design layers (figma-gh-3), and pricing lists 'Advanced Dev Mode inspection' (figma-docs-23). Developers report getting CSS from it (figma-comm-1) and copying assets as SVG (figma-comm-3), and the MCP server can extract variables and styles from a selection (figma-docs-68). A community report says Dev Mode moved to a separate paid license in 2024 (figma-comm-4), so the 'without an editor seat' access model is only implied, not documented. missing for 10: explicit documentation of measurement/redline inspection, iOS/Android snippet support, documented seat/licensing terms for Dev Mode access without an editor seat, in-depth first-party Dev Mode docs.
